name: wan2.7-image-pro
description: Wan2.7-Image-Pro is a professional image generation model with multi-resolution support. Generates high-quality images at 512x512 and 1024x1024 resolutions, suitable for professional design, marketing materials, and creative content.
zhDescription: Wan2.7-Image-Pro是专业级图像生成模型，支持多分辨率。可生成512x512和1024x1024分辨率的高质量图片，适用于专业设计、营销素材和创意内容。
longDescription: Wan2.7-Image-Pro is a professional image generation model with multi-resolution support. Generates high-quality images at 512x512 and 1024x1024 resolutions, suitable for professional design, marketing materials, and creative content.
